slides.sub: Unconventional methods, high risk, high reward — the season that rewrites the plan.

slides.body: Rahu (the north lunar node) dasha runs 18 years. It pulls you toward what is new, foreign and off-script. The old playbook stops working, and new ones are tried.

slides.h2: Why it feels different from Saturn Dasha
slides.body: Saturn Dasha asked you to build slowly on a solid base. Rahu Dasha asks you to experiment, and it rewards the person willing to leave the base behind.

points: Chasing every shiny pivot without testing it
Hype-driven decisions you can't explain later

slides.body: Run small, reversible experiments. Keep a stable core running while you test the unconventional move. This phase pays off for the pivot that survives evidence.
